name: outagedeck
description: Check live cloud and SaaS incidents before debugging code.

interface.shortDescription: Check vendor outages before changing code
interface.longDescription: Check live status, incident timelines, and independent uptime history for 172 cloud and SaaS vendors before changing code. Public OutageDeck tools are read-only, free, and require no account. The bundled triage workflow turns vendor evidence into a citable is-it-us-or-them verdict and concrete next steps.
defaultPrompt: Before changing code, check whether my cloud and SaaS dependencies are having incidents.
Is this 503 from my app or from AWS, Cloudflare, GitHub, or OpenAI?
Create a citable incident brief for the active provider outage.
